evals.name: codex-immediate-exit-empty-stderr-classify-e2
evals.prompt: codex 호출했더니 exit 1이 나왔는데 stderr 는 완전히 비어있고 wall time 이 1초도 안 됐어. 이거 어느 분류야? retry 해야 해?
evals.expected_output: E2 분류 (즉시 종료 + 무 stderr: exit ≠ 0 AND stderr ≤ 1 byte AND wall < 2s). retry 없음. critic opus fallback 으로 진행.

assertions.text: Response classifies this as E2 (즉시 종료 + 무 stderr) per §Fallback 사다리: exit ≠ 0 AND stderr ≤ 1 byte AND wall < 2s
Response states retry = X (no retry) for E2 classification
Response specifies fallback to oh-my-claudecode:critic (opus, model 생략 → 메인 버전 상속) as the E2 fallback path
Response cites the E2 detection criteria: stderr ≤ 1 byte AND wall < 2s — distinguishing it from E4 (stderr > 1 byte OR wall ≥ 2s)
Response specifies that the fallback critic opus response must be saved to a verdict file, not only kept in chat history
